meta.name: Not a Stranger
meta.description:
After giving birth, painter Funda put her career on hold to focus on her child. Ready to return to painting, she finally finds the nanny she has been searching for: Nazlı. But the mysterious and increasingly unsettling woman soon begins to disrupt the seemingly peaceful lives of Funda and her husband İlker. What begins as a simple employment arrangement develops into a dangerous psychological game in which desire, secrets and loyalty are put to the test.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 17 Sept 2026 · Turkey · Language: Turkish

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

On your server — Audio: Turkish

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Struggling to keep her marriage alive, Funda is overcome with the stresses of first-time motherhood, until the perfect caretaker walks into her life.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Funda's hunger to get back in her art studio is enough to overlook the details of İlker's confession… But is there more to his story?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: While Funda makes an effort to get to know Nazlı a bit better, İlker tries to keep his distance but can't help keeping a watchful eye on her.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Funda can't wait to leave town for work when her in-laws drop in for a visit, but İlker escapes the crossfire by getting lost in old memories.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Returning to her studio, Funda gets the sense that something is off. Ridden with guilt and fear, Nazlı attempts to sidestep her suspicions.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: With Emre's life on the line, Nazlı is consumed by memories of her own accident. İlker worries that Emre will wake up and divulge his secret.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: As her exhibition prepares to launch, Funda is unable to shake the events leading up to Emre's fate and all she has come to know about her husband.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: As everything she's built goes up in flames, Funda seeks help, realizing that her mental state has become a danger to her life and her family.
